posts.meta_description:
17K likes, 375 comments - shreemayireddyy on October 15, 2024: "#67 @forbesindia Top 100 Digital Stars 2024😭❤️‍🔥

Look Mumma and Pappaaaa your little girl has made it to Forbes. 
5 years of consistency and hard work feels so worth it today🥺♥️

I’m sooo emotional and happy today. Started in 2019 to represent brown girlies. To be recognized from South India and represent my state on a larger scale. To empower women and bring a small change. This was all just a teenage dream. 

This could not be ever possible without you guys! 2023 has been the hardest on me mentally and physically. I kept going because of my online family. The huge support and love that you guys show me every single day. THANKYOU MY BABIES♥️

Thankyou for everything you’ve given me. Thankyou @forbesindia for recognizing the work we’ve put in. I owe it to you guys, to my team @honeycombtalent and to my loved ones. 

I’M SOOOOO HAPPYYYYYYY🥹❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
If I could do this, You could do this too. NEVER STOP DREAMING✨

[ Forbes digital stars, Forbes top 100 digital starts, forbes top creators, Forbes India 2024 ]".

23K likes, 104 comments - shreemayireddyy on October 11, 2026: "NAVRATHRI IS HEREEEEE💕✨

Over the last 7 years I never missed a navrathri series and we did creator collaborations, navrang navrathri, outfit from scratches and soo many more as our theme. 

This year my theme is bridal looks and this is dedicated to all my brides and bridesmaids who send me hundreds of dms to create looks💕

Also this for a part of me who thought is going to be a 2026 bride. Who needs a groom to create some surreal wedding moodboard anyway? 

 From this series, you can take my recommendations for literally everything wedding. 
From designers to makeup artists. Jewellery to even event planner. 💕✨

Hope upu huys are hoing to love this series as much as I loved making it✨

Happy Navrathri bangarams🥰

Outfit- @madhurirao_couture 
Makeup- @makeupstoriesbyrajeshwari 
Jewellery- @seetagoldanddiamonds 
Hair and draping - @hairbyranialluri 
Jadabillalu and waist belt - @amyrasilver 

Location- @shobhacollective_gandipet 
Styled by your one and only SR🧚‍♀️".
